no_context.text: The system uses a combination of techniques to detect satellite-detectable flood polygons in the NeoGraph graph. First, it identifies flood polygons that are not connected to any other polygon in the graph. Then, it calculates the distance between each flood polygon and all other polygons in a neighborhood of 100 meters. If a flood polygon is within 150 meters of any other flood polygon, it is considered impassable and is added to the Neograph graph as an impassable edge.
